body.heading: About this sheet
paragraphs: Free SparkKindly Kids counting printable: Count and Write 06.
Pictures to count carefully and numbers to write — touch each picture once, say the number out loud, and write the total in the box.

body.heading: How to use it
paragraphs: Print the sheet and count each row together the first time: point, count, write. Crossing off or dotting each counted picture helps nobody get counted twice.

takeaway: Counting real pictures — and writing the number — is how numbers stop being a song and start being maths.
materials: Counters or buttons for children who like to move things as they count
supervision: Count the first row together, then let them drive — ask "how do you know?" and enjoy the reasoning.
safetyNotes: If you use small counters, keep them away from children under 3 — they are a choking hazard.
Print at 100% size (not "fit to page") so the sheet keeps its true size and the pictures stay the size they were drawn.
screenFreeExtension: Count real things on a walk — red cars, round stones, dogs — and keep a tally on the back of the sheet.
